environment.description: Application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) running directly via gunicorn on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy, no load balancer, no WAF. The application is accessed directly by IP address. Instance IAM role has no relevance to the HTTP layer.

config.network: Security group sg-0a1b2c3d allows inbound 8080/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0
